limitations: Only five building footprints are present in the source extract.
The 2009 AKS photos, 2020-02-18 official interior photos and public 2015 survey-plan thumbnails inform a pre-repair reference model; this is not a current-site scan.

OSM outlines are interpreted as roof coverage. Column grid, eave heights, joinery, painted motifs and landscape coordinates are photo-proportioned estimates, not measured dimensions. Published area figures differ.
The center door is opened for exploration. Gate upper-floor access and concealed room construction are not reconstructed.
Terrain is flat. Road centerlines are sourced; road widths are estimates.
